records.name: Cleared
records.tagline: Your personal plan to give up vapes, pouches and cigarettes
records.description: Most people who quit nicotine try without a plan. Cleared builds one from what you use, then helps every day: a check-in, a daily coach, one-tap logging and Craving SOS for the hard moments. Took a home nicotine test? Snap a photo and AI reads the result.

records.name: Enrichable by Context.dev
records.tagline: Open-source AI spreadsheet for data enrichment
records.description: Free, open-source AI spreadsheet for data enrichment. Build lead lists from a prompt, research every row with live web data, and find work emails.

records.name: Every Signal
records.tagline: Diligence on any company in an hour, every number sourced
records.description: Every Signal's research agents take a company and a question and return a sourced teardown: traffic, ads, tracking stack, pricing, revenue math, competitors and rules. Every figure is tagged verified, estimate, inferred or rumour. Then it watches for changes.

records.name: Room AI
records.tagline: Talk to it like a designer. Your room, one change at a time
records.description: Upload a photo of your room and say what you'd change. Each reply is a new photo of your room with that change made and the rest left as it was. Every version kept, compare any two. No credits to count. Try it on your room first, no card.

records.name: Meilisearch Searchandising
records.tagline: Pin, boost, hide and personalize search results
records.description: New in Meilisearch Cloud: search rules and personalization. Build rules in a visual editor: drag a product to the top, boost or deboost by any filter, and hide what you don’t want to sell. Trigger rules on specific searches, category pages or every query, and schedule them for campaigns like Black Friday. Compare results with and without a rule before it goes live, no deploy needed. Personalization reranks results per user (experimental, on request). Same rules via the API, 3 free per project.

records.name: Play That Back
records.tagline: A pro camera built for iPhone Duo
records.description: Play That Back is a pro camera designed around the fold. Frame and control your shot inside while the person you're filming sees the live picture and chooses their look outside. Get cinematic looks, professional controls, and a clean original with every shot. It also works on iPhone and iPad. And on Mac, turn Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok videos, photos, and AI videos into Recipes, compare your takes, and build your own looks.

records.name: Source
records.tagline: The attribution data layer for your agents to drive pipeline
records.description: Source turns your website and CRM data into attribution your agents can query over MCP. Install the pixel, connect your CRM, then add Source from the Claude or OpenAI marketplace. Your agent can ask where pipeline came from and get the answer plus the SQL behind it. Six attribution models on every touch, from first visit to closed deal. SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001. Free up to 100,000 events a month. No credit card.

records.name: CodeDesign v3
records.tagline: Run your website and business apps from ChatGPT or Claude
records.description: CodeDesign v3 turns an AI website builder into the place your business runs. Build a site from one sentence on 2,000+ designer templates, then run it from one new dashboard: domains, bookings, AI chatbot, forms, analytics, SEO checks, blog, email and social. New: connect CodeDesign to ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor and do it all from the chat you already use. It still hosts on your domain, publishes to WordPress and exports code. 4M+ sites built.

records.name: Manufact
records.tagline: Ship and test your MCP to every plugin marketplace
records.description: Manufact helps teams publish MCP servers and plugins, understand how agents use them, and test releases across clients. Bring publishing checks, session traces and cross-client tests into one workflow.

records.name: Ableten Hybrid AI Travel Planner
records.tagline: Get your group on the same map.
records.description: Group travel planning is hard: differing preferences, scattered recs, endless group chats. Ableten is a hybrid AI trip planner built for that mess. Ask for “ramen near Shinjuku” or “a Saturday in Lisbon” and get personalized suggestions on a real map — places you can drag into a shared itinerary. Everyone on the trip can add and pick what they love so that you can make real memories with friends, hassle free

records.name: Impractical
records.tagline: Make launch videos in the style of Framer, Notion, and more
records.description: Pick a video template you like and make it about your product. Add your UI, copy and brand, then tell the AI what to change. Impractical helps founders and marketers make launch videos, feature announcements and explainers without building every video from scratch. Get started for free at impractical.ai! PS: If you're planning on doing your own launch, need a video, and don't know where to start, reach out! We're happy to directly work with startups to get them kickass videos with Impractical.

records.name: HeyGen Avatar 6
records.tagline: AI Avatar Model That Looks Like You
records.description: Avatar 6 is HeyGen’s most realistic AI avatar model, 84.4% indistinguishable from real footage. Your first video is free.

records.name: Fieldwork Code
records.tagline: AI coding on your laptop or in the cloud, from your phone
records.description: Run parallel AI coding sessions with your choice of harness (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi or Fieldwork's own) and model, locally via our desktop app (free) or in cloud sandboxes ($50/mo). Pick up any session from the web or the Fieldwork mobile app. A side pane gives you a terminal, file diffs, PR status and CI checks, plus one-click instructions and inline diff reviews for your agent. Built on Fieldwork, so it comes with 3,000+ connectors, tasks and a knowledge base.

records.name: Gemini 4 Neon
records.tagline: Frontier reasoning with faster task completion
records.description: Gemini 4 Neon brings frontier-level reasoning to faster coding, research, and agent workflows. Adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon, it supports multimodal inputs and a 1M-token context window, with access through the Gemini API, AI Studio, and Antigravity.

records.name: ToolJet
records.tagline: Vibe-coded business apps that pass the security review
records.description: Let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor build your internal tools in React. ToolJet is the platform underneath: 100+ data integrations, a built-in database, permissions, security scans on every save, version reviews, and workflows with human approvals.

records.name: Tecla
records.tagline: A proactive AI agent whose interface is a TODO list
records.description: Tecla is a proactive AI assistant for work. It finds everything that's on your plate and turns it into a curated TODO list. You can click any item and Tecla does it for you. No prompts and no more text threads. You will never leave anything behind again. Just chat with people on Slack, exchange emails, have meetings, and tecla will understand what has to be done from those and surface the work, with all the required context.

records.name: The Calm Creator Mastermind
records.tagline: For solopreneurs who are tired of being solo.
records.description: This is a small mastermind for creators, community builders, and indie founders who want to grow their business on their own terms, design a life they love, and treat their nervous system as a core measure of success alongside revenue. Other masterminds focus on growth at all costs. In this group, we're much more conscious of those costs. We commit to living a calm, balanced, and integrated life while growing the businesses and lives of our dreams.

records.name: TestSprite 4.0
records.tagline: Fix one thing, break another? This agent checks it all
records.description: Your coding agent fixes one thing and breaks another. TestSprite 4.0 is a brand-new testing agent that remembers what your app should do and checks all of it, every time. Tell it in plain words what to test. It explores your running app, writes and runs the end-to-end tests, tells you which failures are real bugs, and keeps checking every change from the web, your terminal or your pull requests.

records.name: Stripo Email Widgets
records.tagline: Put a game, quiz or survey in your next email. No coding
records.description: Put a scratch card, quiz, poll, NPS survey or event agenda into your email. Drag a widget into the Stripo editor, then tell the AI Assistant what to change: text, colors, questions, prizes. Each of the 20+ widgets comes with its design, interaction and fallback logic built in. It plays where the inbox supports interactivity and shows a clean static block where it doesn't. Save the container and reuse it in any template. Available on every plan, including Free.

records.name: Netlify Server
records.tagline: Run WebSockets, multiplayer apps, and long-running agents
records.description: Netlify Server gives your app a backend that stays alive while people are using it. Build realtime experiences, multiplayer games, and AI agents that need time to finish. Describe what you want and an agent builds it, or bring your Express, Fastify, Hono, or Koa code. It holds WebSockets open, keeps state in memory, and deploys with the rest of your project, with its own server for every preview. Scales with demand and down to zero when idle. Free during early access.

records.name: Teaflask
records.tagline: Self-improving AI copilot for your app. No backend changes.
records.description: Turn your existing SaaS into an AI-native product without rebuilding your backend. Teaflask adds a managed AI copilot that lets users get things done by simply asking. Integrate through your frontend, use your own UI components, and go live in a day. Teaflask keeps its product knowledge grounded in your code, learns from real usage, and lets you test changes before release.

records.name: Tabstack by Mozilla
records.tagline: Give your model the web without giving up your privacy
records.description: Research, extract, and automate the web from one managed API. Get a cited answer, clean text, matching JSON, or a completed browser task from the live web in one call. We run the browsers and the web loop outside your model, so you build your agent without building its web stack. Never trained on. Private by default. Built by Mozilla. Start free with 10,000 credits.

records.name: Spellar for Chrome
records.tagline: Free, no-bot meeting notes with memory, now in your browser
records.description: Spellar for Chrome takes no-bot meeting notes on Windows and Mac, right in your browser, with no desktop app to install. It records Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex, and nothing joins the call. On Google Meet, transcripts show real speaker names. Every call goes into one memory with your Spellar Mac and iPhone notes, so you can ask what a client said three calls ago. Send notes to Slack or Notion and pick Claude, GPT or Gemini. Start with 300 free minutes, no card needed.

records.name: OfinTech Desk
records.tagline: Finance AI where every figure traces to its source
records.description: Open-source AI workspace for finance teams where every figure traces to its source. Connect QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books or Odoo read-only and get statements, month-end close, KPIs and an assistant in Arabic or English. The AI explains; it never invents a number. Pro adds payment settlements, learning from your team's decisions and the Ofin model: no GPU, 0.03 ms per bank line on a 2-core CPU. Runs on your own servers.

records.name: Noteshell
records.tagline: AI teammates that build and run your workspace
records.description: Noteshell is an AI workspace that can run itself once you decide what to delegate and when. Its AI teammates make custom dashboards, trackers, interactive notes, and mini-apps you can use together right inside Noteshell. No coding required. An agent can make your job tracker, then find and add matching roles each morning. Your workspace files live in folders on your computer.

records.name: Adside
records.tagline: A team of specialized AI agents that manage paid ads for you
records.description: A team of specialized AI agents that manage your paid ads on Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit and Twitter. Run it yourself, or have one of our human experts manage it for you.

records.name: Verse Engine by Ctruh
records.tagline: Blender, Unity or Unreal to a live 3D link in one click
records.description: Verse Engine by Ctruh is a browser-native 3D and XR engine that turns any 3D into one link. Bring files, scans and floor plans, or publish straight from Blender, Unity and Unreal. The link opens in any browser with no app and no download. Built for developers, 3D artists, game studios, architects, real estate teams and e-commerce brands. A scene streams only what the viewer sees, so a 10.3 billion triangle city opens from a link on a laptop. Embeds, API and SDK included. Free 14-day Pro trial.

records.name: Rezora IO
records.tagline: Shopify for AI voice agents: live in 10 minutes
records.description: Rezora is the first AI voice platform that gives HVAC, plumbing, roofing and other home service companies self improving AI receptionists with setup and launch taking only 10 minutes. They answer the customer's questions, qualify the job, and book it on your calendar.

records.name: Nuko
records.tagline: Motion design in your browser
records.description: Open a template or start from scratch. Animate posts, stories and videos, then export.

records.name: Upsolve MCP Connections
records.tagline: Plug Notion, Linear and more into your data agent
records.description: Attach any MCP server to your Upsolve agent. Your agent still answers from governed warehouse data, and can now read and write where your team works: save an analysis to Notion, open a Linear ticket, pull context from docs.

records.name: Wispr Flow Notetaker for iPhone
records.tagline: Free AI meeting notes, wherever work takes you
records.description: Wispr Flow Notetaker is now on iPhone. Capture in-person meetings on your phone and virtual meetings on desktop, for free. All your notes stay together across devices, so you can pick up right where you left off.

records.name: Polylane for Azure
records.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Azure apps
records.description: Polylane investigates Azure Monitor alerts, traces the cause through logs, metrics and resource changes, and prepares code fixes for review. It maps your subscription and connects it to your repos and other clouds. Connect through Azure Lighthouse with one template and no stored Azure credentials.

records.name: mio click
records.tagline: A fidget that's also a friend
records.description: mio click is a handheld clicker with one mechanical button and a tiny screen. Hatch a Squig, Goober or Meatball. No two are the same, and yours moves every time you press. It counts every click anywhere you take it, then syncs over Wi-Fi to a public leaderboard where you can see how your mio ranks, hatch a new one or swap with a friend. Assembled by hand in small batches by a team of parents. The button is rated for 50 million clicks.

records.name: Alfred 6
records.tagline: Supercharging macOS since 2010
records.description: Alfred 6 brings Alfred UI, a new macOS-native toolkit creators can use to build lightweight workflows with real interfaces. Plus a fresh look across themes and preferences, a new Query History, and extended Clipboard History. Built for lightweight efficiency, stability and speed.

records.name: No BS Weather: Feels Like
records.tagline: Feels-like first, with a short summary and a free widget
records.description: The thermometer and the feels-like number often disagree. This app puts the feels-like first, then a short summary of what the day means. Free, no ads, no account. Requires iOS 26. English, French, German, Spanish and Portuguese.

records.name: PACT Payroll Management
records.tagline: Streamline Salary Processing with Complete Accuracy
records.description: Discover how payroll software for small businesses helps UAE companies streamline salary processing, automate calculations, manage employee records and simplify HR tasks. Handle salaries, allowances, deductions, leave records and payroll reports efficiently. PACT Payroll Software reduces manual work, improves payroll accuracy, organizes employee information and supports timely salary processing for better workforce management and business efficiency.

records.name: AI Tools & Affiliate Marketing Guide
records.tagline: AI tools and affiliate marketing for beginners
records.description: A beginner-friendly eBook about AI tools and affiliate marketing, created from approximately 6 years of affiliate marketing learning and experience. Learn niche selection, AI-powered content creation, honest product reviews, and affiliate promotion. Includes practical AI prompts, useful checklists, and a 30-day action plan to help beginners get started.

records.name: Mearc
records.tagline: GitHub for research, with humans and AI agents
records.description: Research is increasingly written by humans and AI together. But who contributed what, which evidence supports a claim, and why did a conclusion change? Mearc brings scientific pull requests to research: version papers and experiments, review evidence-backed claims, track human and AI contributions, and export a Research Passport. Built for researchers and AI agents working together, with human review before publishing scientific conclusions.

records.name: Glowstand – Music Visualizer
records.tagline: Turn your iPhone or iPad into an LED spectrum analyzer
records.description: Glowstand turns your iPhone or iPad into an LED spectrum analyzer, like the meters on studio gear. It listens through the microphone, so it works with anything that plays in the room: music from a streaming service, a turntable or an instrument. Turn on Transmit on one device and any other device on the same Wi-Fi network can show the panel too, each in its own layout and colors. 12 layouts, 39 themes, 9 screensavers. And the Album Art Colors theme takes the colors of the song's cover.

records.name: Localist
records.tagline: Food tours: visit like a tourist, eat like a local
records.description: Skip the tourist traps, eat where locals eat. Self-guided food tours through hand-picked local spots, at your own pace, every tasting included. Pick a tour, choose your date and go: the app guides you stop by stop on a map, with the story behind each place. At every stop, your tasting is waiting for you. No guide, no group to follow, no extra bill. Starting with Paris, more cities soon. On iOS and Android.

records.name: Kindred Voice
records.tagline: Build a reliable voice agent with no prompt
records.description: You’re burning runway, credits, and months of engineering time to build and maintain reliable voice agents. Kindred solves that. Stop staring at your prompts, let Kindred handle it for you, and be the 100x engineer. Upload your context to Kindred or just use the MCP to get a custom voice agent in minutes. Works with any speech to speech model. Follows your process exactly every time. No more endless testing, and Kindred self-improves over time. Test it out: Code PRODUCTHUNT: 1 month of Pro free.

records.name: QuickRisk
records.tagline: Quantitative Cyber Risk & Prioritization
records.description: An independently developed FAIR-inspired quantitative cyber-risk application that uses probabilistic modelling and quantitative analysis to explore the possible range of loss associated with defined cyber-risk scenarios instead of presenting risk as a single deterministic score. It is a rapid starting point for understanding likelihood, loss exposure and uncertainty, and not a substitute for a full FAIR analysis.

records.name: Small Canon
records.tagline: Turn your nine favorite books into a shareable shelfie!
records.description: Some books stay with you. The ones you couldn't put down, can't stop recommending, or wish you could read again for the first time. Small Canon is a free little tool for celebrating those books. Pick nine that matter to you, "print" a poster, and share your recs with friends and fellow readers. No account required. No ads, no cost. Just a fun way to share the books that made an impression on you.

records.name: Seven Star Window
records.tagline: Window tinting & car care for cars, homes and offices
records.description: Seven Star Window is a Rouse Hill, Sydney studio for car window tinting, ceramic and graphene coating, car wrapping, headlight restoration and tail light wraps, plus residential and commercial tinting. Free quote within 24 hours.

records.name: WarrantyTracker Pro
records.tagline: Track product warranties & receipts before coverage expires
records.description: WarrantyTracker Pro is a modern warranty management and receipt tracking platform. We help homeowners, families, and short-term rental hosts protect their purchases by capturing receipts via email forwarding, tracking expiration dates, and sending timely alerts before manufacturer coverage runs out. Forward receipts by email or upload photos and PDF invoices directly. Track property inventory and appliance warranty lifecycles in one place.

records.name: NookMallow
records.tagline: One apartment budget. One shoppable furniture list.
records.description: NookMallow helps you furnish an entire apartment on one budget. Split it across rooms, pick a style, and find furniture from real retailers. Keep prices and store links in one shopping list you can download as a CSV. In our $5,000 one-bedroom example, we planned three rooms and selected 11 product listings totaling $2,767.13 before tax and shipping.

records.name: Bestboy
records.tagline: Make a wish(list) from link, photo, voice, or ChatGPT
records.description: Bestboy is a free wishlist app for families & friends who swap gifts. Save gift ideas for yourself or anyone you love: paste a link, snap a photo, or just say it. Collaborate on lists for a wedding registry, your child’s birthday or any occasion. Share one link, let people reserve gifts without signing up, so nobody buys the same thing twice. Unlike static wishlists, Bestboy reminds you of birthdays and gifts to buy. On iOS (even offline), web, Chrome, ChatGPT, Claude, Grok via MCP. Make a wish!

records.name: AgentDrive
records.tagline: Resume coding sessions across AI agents
records.description: Hit your limit in one coding agent? Continue in another with the same context. AgentDrive syncs sessions across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor and Antigravity and hands the next agent the goal, files touched and recent turns. Open source, free plan.

records.name: Atomik Trading
records.tagline: Automated futures strategies in your own broker account
records.description: Atomik runs automated futures strategies on its servers and sends each order, with a stop and a target attached, to a futures account in your name — typically Tradovate or NinjaTrader. Atomik never holds your money and cannot withdraw it. Describe rules in plain words; ARIA builds and backtests them. Paper account on every plan. Builder is $49 a month. Futures trading involves substantial risk of loss and is not suitable for every investor.

records.name: Gps track
records.tagline: Live GPS tracking for cars, pets and phones, via Telegram
records.description: Gps track shows your trackers on a live OpenStreetMap map, using Telegram instead of a tracking server. Link a GPS tracker bot or turn your own phone into a tracker, see battery and speed, review any route in Location History, and get alerts when a device enters or leaves a zone. No ads and no subscription: the Free plan tracks 1 device, and a one-time Pro upgrade unlocks unlimited devices. Android 7.0+. Register through our Telegram bot to get the app.

records.name: Burnstack
records.tagline: Every dev and AI bill in one place, on your own Mac
records.description: Burnstack reads the bills of 32 dev and AI vendors, from Vercel and Neon to OpenAI, Anthropic and AWS, and imports PDF or CSV invoices for the rest. See the whole bill in one view, what each product costs, and get a heads-up before a spike becomes an invoice. Runs on your Mac only: no account, keys in your keychain, your data in one file on your disk. Free.

records.name: Flovvy
records.tagline: Pro-grade receipt AI reading every line, in an expense app
records.description: We started with receipt-scanning accuracy, combining 3 technologies in an engine designed for B2B. Then we built Flovvy on top of it, an expense tracker built around AI: - reads every line of your receipts (products, weights, quantities, unit costs, discounts) - compares prices across your stores and shows how much you could save - answers any question about your spending - plus the essentials: budgets, group expenses, charts, end-of-month projection, tags, recurring expenses, accounts

records.name: Paw Backer
records.tagline: From pet care to pet services, everything starts here.
records.description: Your pet deserves the best — and finding the right care should be simple. Meet **Paw Backer**, your companion for managing pet life, discovering pet services, and keeping your furry family members happy and healthy. Whether you're a devoted pet parent or a pet care professional, Paw Backer helps bring the pet care journey together in one convenient place. Create pet profiles and keep important details about your beloved companions organized.

records.name: BabooTools Hub
records.tagline: Free online calculators & tools, no sign-up, instant results
records.description: BabooTools Hub is a free collection of 11 online tools: Age Calculator, Salary to Hourly Calculator, GPA Calculator, Days Between Dates Calculator, Word Counter, Image Compressor, Percentage Calculator, BMI Calculator, Loan Calculator, Password Generator and QR Code Generator. Every tool runs instantly in your browser, no sign-up, no uploads, no fuss. Most work fully offline and never send your data anywhere. Built for students, professionals and anyone who needs a quick, accurate answer.

records.name: Goldcrest
records.tagline: Your financial plan, one question at a time
records.description: I built Goldcrest in Toronto for my own use in the hope it helps others. I was discussing financial planning (specifically a rent vs buy scenario with my wife) and found that it requires a surprising number of variables and complexity to do proper modelling/forecasting (the model implementation is a Monte-Carlo simulation under the hood). The idea is an AI chat agent reduces the complexity and tediousness of form-filling, and will help prompt users similarly to a financial advisor.

records.name: شركة التميز للمقاولات والديكور
records.tagline: شركة التميز للمقاولات والديكور| واجهات حجر هاشمي وفرعوني
records.description: تتخصص شركة التميز للمقاولات والديكور في توريد وتركيب حجر هاشمي هيصم لتشطيب واجهات المنازل والفلل والعمارات. يتميز الحجر الهيصم بلونه الطبيعي وملمسه المميز، ويُستخدم في تصميم الواجهات الكلاسيكية والحديثة. نقدم خدمات معاينة الواجهات وتحديد المقاسات واختيار التشطيب المناسب، مع تنفيذ الكرانيش والحليات وتقدير تكلفة المشروع حسب المساحة ومتطلبات التنفيذ.

records.name: Lookoteca
records.tagline: Visual references for treatment designers & creative pros
records.description: Find the shot you have in mind. Lookoteca helps directors, treatment designers, and creative researchers search a library of visual references with a description, image, or video. Explore similar looks and spend less time hunting for your next treatment. Keep your eyes curious.

records.name: India Clean Energy Events Guide 2027
records.tagline: Find the right clean energy event before you register.
records.description: India Clean Energy Events Guide 2027 brings the year’s renewable energy conferences and expos into one place. See dates, venues and focus areas side by side, understand how conferences differ from trade exhibitions, and use a simple checklist to judge the agenda, speakers and organisers before paying. Built for project developers, investors, suppliers, students and policy professionals who want to plan their event calendar with confidence.

records.name: BinaDesk
records.tagline: BinaDesk checks AI’s work against your own documents
records.description: BinaDesk does the work with AI, then checks it against your own documents before it reaches you. Anything a check cannot confirm is marked, not guessed. Five services, free for now: bank statements to Excel, real estate models and T-12s, document extraction to Excel or Word, construction takeoffs and client estimates from PDF plans, and checks of work another AI already made. Built for bookkeepers, accountants, lenders, real estate investors and contractors.

records.name: TVBridge Remote Browser
records.tagline: Browse the web on Apple TV with your Siri Remote
records.description: Browse websites on your Apple TV from the sofa. TVBridge streams a dedicated WebKit browser running on your Mac, with picture, sound and Siri Remote controls. Navigate links, scroll and play videos while using your Mac for other tasks. Requires a Mac and Apple TV on the same network. Free for 10 minutes a day; Premium unlocks unlimited use.

records.name: SoloerShip
records.tagline: A weekly launch board for indie makers
records.description: SoloerShip is a weekly launch board for indie makers and small teams. A new board opens every Monday, so your product gets a full week of attention instead of a single day. The community votes all week, and the top three become Products of the Week with a badge and a dofollow link. Free to submit; add our badge to your homepage and your link is dofollow too. Every launch keeps a permanent product page, and makers get a public profile.

records.name: Get Paid Invoice Tracker
records.tagline: Get Paid: Invoice Follow-Up Tool. Pay Once, Own It Forever
records.description: Chasing late payments is awkward, and forgetting to do it costs you money. Get Paid tells you exactly who to follow up with each day and writes the message for you. What you get A daily "who to chase" list, with the most overdue first Reminder messages in 5 stages, from friendly to final notice, picked by how late the invoice is Copy the message, or open it in email or WhatsApp Promise to Pay: record the date a client promised to pay and see broken promises Overdue aging: unpaid invoices…

records.name: https://aqarsky.com
records.tagline: https://aqarsky.com
records.description: عقار سكاي منصة عقارية متخصصة في السوق المصري، تساعدك على اكتشاف الكمبوندات والمشروعات السكنية والتجارية والقرى السياحية، ومقارنة الأسعار والمساحات وأنظمة السداد. توفر المنصة معلومات عن المطورين العقاريين والوحدات المتاحة، إلى جانب أدلة عقارية واستشارات تساعدك على اختيار العقار المناسب للسكن أو الاستثمار بثقة.

records.name: Devalley | Unified Agent Control
records.tagline: Every agent, from any terminal, IDE or app, in one window
records.description: Unified Agent Control | Devalley An AI coding agent dashboard as a village on your computer: all your Claude Code and Codex sessions are villagers. They bring notifications when a session needs approval or is done, and you see usage, answers and changed code in one place. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI… Free for Windows and macOS.

records.name: Umbra: Shoot Planner
records.tagline: Golden hour to paid invoices, in one free iPhone app
records.description: Umbra is a free iPhone shoot planner for photographers and videographers. It works out sunrise, sunset, golden hour and blue hour for any spot, checks the light when you book and offers to move the shoot to golden hour, and gives you a shoot-day brief with leave-by time, forecast, shot list and mood board. Quotes, PDF invoices, expenses and a tax-time pack sit alongside. No accounts, ads or tracking: your data stays on your iPhone and in your own iCloud, and it works offline.

records.name: Cyber Resilience Act Gap Finder
records.tagline: Duties and gaps for every connected product you sell
records.description: Paste your product list, one line per product. Every connected product read against the EU Cyber Resilience Act, the UK PSTI rules and California

records.name: Purple Flow
records.tagline: AI-first n8n alternative on the BEAM — 10k flows, 512MB
records.description: Purple Flow is an AI-first alternative to n8n — it makes building automated workflows as easy for AI as n8n makes it for people.
