records.name: OnCrew
records.tagline: Paste your website, call your own AI receptionist
records.description: OnCrew answers a small business's phone in its name: it takes the caller's details, flags urgent calls, transfers to you once you give it a number, and emails you every call. New: type your website and US mobile on oncrew.ai and in under a minute a real number that answers as your business is on the page, and in one text. No account, no card. Keep it free for 14 days on the same number, or start for $1 ($1 today, then $49 a month).

records.name: InboxTrue
records.tagline: Email verification. Checked, not guessed.
records.description: InboxTrue verifies individual email addresses, even on catch-all domains where many tools stop at ‘unknown’. Address-level verdicts, disposable detection, realtime + bulk API, MCP for Claude and ChatGPT. Free checker, no signup.

records.name: Yantra
records.tagline: An AI assistant that does the task, not just the advice
records.description: One chat that gets things done. Ask for an image, video or voice-over and get the file. Ask for a deck, doc or spreadsheet and it's saved, ready to edit. Ask it to compare prices, plan a trip or fill a form, and it works in your own browser or on a cloud computer you can watch. Create AI characters with their own voice and memory. Nothing is posted, sent or bought without your OK.

records.name: Video Compressor for Mac
records.tagline: Free Video Compressor for Mac
records.description: Compress any video to the exact size you need: under 400 MB for Claude, 512 MB for ChatGPT, or 25 MB for email. No confusing settings — drop a video, pick a size, done. Everything runs on your Mac; nothing is uploaded. Connect it to Claude or ChatGPT/Codex and just ask in chat: “compress this video to 100 MB”. Progress shows up right in your MacBook’s notch.

records.name: ImproveThing
records.tagline: Small habits and flexible goals, with friendly Things
records.description: Build habits with small, adjustable steps. Log water, reading, movement or your own routine on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. Friendly Things react as you log, and milestones count completed days even when they are not consecutive. Free download; eligible subscribers get a 7-day trial, then Pro with monthly or annual billing.

records.name: Walk Me Up Alarm Clock
records.tagline: The alarm that stops ringing only when you walk
records.description: Stop losing your mornings to the snooze button. Walk Me Up only goes quiet once you've walked a set number of steps. By then you're out of bed and awake, not making deals with your phone. Set it once and get your mornings back.

records.name: Simple Unmark
records.tagline: Remove AI watermarks from your text, privately
records.description: Simple Unmark removes AI watermarks from your text. Paste it in and the app strips the invisible characters some AI tools add, then rephrases it with a different model to change the word-choice patterns behind statistical watermarks like SynthID Text and textGrain. The rewrite aims to keep your meaning and facts. Copy the result and you're done. Private by default: your text and the output aren't saved in our database or analytics. Free to try.

records.name: Tintloom
records.tagline: Make and edit images inside Claude chats
records.description: Tintloom adds image generation and editing to Claude. Ask for a poster or a cat in sunglasses and it appears in the chat as a card. Select an area to change, erase or resize. Independent, not made or endorsed by Anthropic.

records.name: Sub
records.tagline: AI employees who own responsibilities, not just tasks
records.description: Give an AI employee an ongoing job. They learn your business, do the work and follow through, without a new prompt each time. Each has their own name, email, phone number and computer. You set the work, access and spending limits, track progress and costs, and can pause or stop them. Pricing from $1,000/month.

records.name: Quando
records.tagline: A calendar that shows your free time on a timeline
records.description: A calendar for iPhone, iPad and Mac with a Timeline: one row per day, hours across, free time shown as empty space. Write events the way you talk. No account, no ads, no tracking; syncs through your own iCloud. Free, with optional Pro.

records.name: devrelScore
records.tagline: Audit how developers find your devtool and what to fix
records.description: devrelScore checks how often AI recommends you, your docs, website, GitHub, X and Discord, ranks you against competitors and gives you one score out of 100 with a prioritized list of fixes.

records.name: MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash
records.tagline: Microsoft’s new coding models, at a 50% launch price
records.description: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash are Microsoft AI’s new coding models. Code 2 handles production code, deep debugging, multi-file work and UI. Flash covers explanations, targeted edits and routine fixes at lower cost. Per Microsoft, Code 2 reaches 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol’s performance at 40% of its cost. Both are at a 50% promotional price and available in GitHub Copilot. Flash is also in limited-access preview on Microsoft Foundry.

records.name: macapps.computer
records.tagline: A curated collection of beautifully crafted macOS apps
records.description: A curated collection of beautifully crafted macOS apps. Explore icons, previews, and users’ top picks to find your next favorite Mac app.

records.name: ClipSonic
records.tagline: Turn long videos and live streams into viral shorts with AI
records.description: ClipSonic is a desktop app that turns long YouTube videos, podcasts and live streams into ready-to-post 9:16 shorts. Paste a link or drop in a file: it transcribes the video, uses AI to pick the most viral moments and explains why each one hooks, then lets you trim and export with face-tracked framing and animated captions burned in. New in 2.1: clip YouTube live streams while they air.

records.name: Kairos
records.tagline: Lock in your borrow rate with onchain Interest Rate Swaps
records.description: The first perpetual interest rate swap market for DeFi borrowers. If you borrow on Aave, Morpho, or Compound, your rate floats, sometimes violently. Kairos lets you fix it for 90 days without touching your position, with LPs pooled on the other side. What's different: no dated maturities (markets roll perpetually), no counterparty matching, manipulation-resistant time-weighted rate oracles, audited contracts. Real hedging, not farming. Lock rates, hedge positions and speculate on volatility!

records.name: Leverprice
records.tagline: Grow your revenue with price tests
records.description: Earn more from the traffic you already have. Leverprice tests prices on new visitors, counts only the sales your payment provider confirms, and sends more traffic to the price that earns the most. It also gives every country a fair price from the first visit. Works with Stripe, Paddle, Polar, Lemon Squeezy, Dodo and Creem. Set up with one prompt to your AI agent. Free to start.

records.name: Appetite UI 2.6
records.tagline: Figma UI kit for iOS and Android, now with paywall flows
records.description: Appetite UI is a Figma UI kit for iOS and Android apps, built like a design system. Version 2.6 adds Calendar, Mail and Paywall flows with 36 screens in light and dark, 11 new components such as Payment Card and Scroll Edge, Live Card in five types with motion built in, Material 3 toolbars, button groups and split buttons, and App Store and Google Play pages. The kit now holds 116 screens in 13 flows. Apple and Material components draw in your brand palette. One payment, lifetime updates.

records.name: Wispr Flow Notetaker for iPhone
records.tagline: Free AI meeting notes, wherever work takes you
records.description: Wispr Flow Notetaker is now on iPhone. Capture in-person meetings on your phone and virtual meetings on desktop, for free. All your notes stay together across devices, so you can pick up right where you left off.

records.name: WonderCast
records.tagline: Stories starring your child, told in your voice
records.description: Create stories starring your child, narrated in a familiar voice. WonderCast combines illustrated books, audiobooks, songs and short videos with word-by-word read-along and choose-your-own adventures. Try six stories without an account, then make your own on the web, iPhone or iPad. Parent voice cloning is available on the Creator and Studio plans.

records.name: Beav
records.tagline: AI workspace for RedNote creators · 小红书 AI 创作工作台
records.description: Beav is a local-first desktop workspace for RedNote (Xiaohongshu) creators. Save posts and comments, break down videos, search your library, draft captions and covers, and send your post pack to your phone via QR. Free desktop download. AI runs on credits. Beav 是面向小红书创作者的本地优先桌面工作台。采集笔记与评论，按时间戳拆解视频，在素材库里搜索参考，从选题写到文案和封面，再扫码把发布素材包传到手机。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，免费下载，AI 功能按积分用量计费。

records.name: Spider
records.tagline: One API to scrape, crawl and search the web
records.description: Spider gives your AI agents the web as markdown. Scrape a page, crawl a site or search, all on our own browser engine and network. It is fast, reliable, and starts at 10,000 requests a minute. Try a URL before you sign up.

records.name: Imposter Game
records.tagline: Browser imposter game for 3–99 players, local or online
records.description: Host an imposter word game in the browser, with no app or download. In local mode, pass one device around so 3–99 players can see their roles, with no login. For remote groups, create a private room and share a room code or QR invite; Guest Rooms need no signup. You get 3,600+ official words, 12 languages, custom word packs, a timer, and built-in voting. Core play is free, with optional paid upgrades such as ad removal. Made for parties, classrooms, team building, and family game nights.

records.name: Obviouslead
records.tagline: Interactive video forms that qualify your leads
records.description: Turn a video into an interactive lead form: timed questions, CTAs, lead capture and meeting booking in one shareable link. Track opens, watch time and replays per lead, and see which channel (email, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook) brings them. Also works for hiring: candidates fill a short form, then record one video intro. Free plan available.

records.name: Spaces Utility
records.tagline: Name your Mac desktops and jump to your apps
records.description: Give your Mac desktops names like Writing, Research, and Admin. See those names in Mission Control and when you switch Spaces. Open Workstation Overview from the menu bar to see which apps are on each display and jump straight to a desktop or app window. For Apple silicon Macs on macOS 27.2 or later. Try it free for 7 days, no card required, then pay €9.99 once.

records.name: Voltalyze
records.tagline: Salon bookings, business management and AI assistants
records.description: Voltalyze connects bookings, clients, payments, POS, inventory, reporting and a business website for salons, barbers, spas and wellness professionals. Business adds staff accounts and shared calendars. Paid plans offer AI booking chat and a business assistant with text and microphone input. Lite is free forever with a booking link. Solo: US$19.99/month. Business: US$59.99/month. Try paid plans for 14 days without a card. AI, messaging and payment processing are charged separately.

records.name: Formkove
records.tagline: A form backend that sorts submissions for you
records.description: Formkove reads every form submission before it reaches you. Spam is held back, and the rest get your own tags and a sentiment, so routing rules can send a sales lead to #sales and a bug report to your webhook. Works with Slack, Teams, Discord, Sheets, Airtable, Notion, HubSpot, Zapier, n8n and webhooks, plus an email for each real one. Point any HTML form at one URL. Agencies get a workspace per client, and Claude can set up a form for you (it's in Claude's connector directory).

records.name: Yearbar
records.tagline: The yearly goal tracker that forgives a bad week
records.description: Most goal apps judge you by today. One missed day and the streak is gone, so a lot of resolutions end in February. Yearbar looks at the whole year instead. Every goal gets a bar that races the calendar, with a marker showing where you should be by now: ahead, on pace, or "6 days to catch up". Streaks count weeks and come with freezes. Count books, save money, tick off lists. Free for 5 goals, on iPhone, Android and the web.

records.name: Mountkeeper
records.tagline: Your Mac's SMB network shares, one command away
records.description: Mountkeeper is a native macOS terminal app that remembers your SMB network shares and connects, disconnects and opens them with one command, instead of Finder's Connect to Server dialog. Passwords live only in the macOS Keychain; in Active Directory domains, shares can sign in with your Kerberos ticket. Auto-connect at login and on network changes, network-aware profiles, dead-mount detection, a doctor command and an arrow-key interface. Open source, installed via Homebrew.

records.name: KcalLens
records.tagline: Snap your meal, see calories for every ingredient
records.description: Logging food shouldn't take longer than eating it. Snap a meal and KcalLens breaks the plate into items, with calories, protein, carbs and fat for each one, plus a confidence level so you know which estimates to double-check. Ate only half? Adjust the portion in a tap. Not sure what to eat next? Get recipe ideas that fit what you have left today. Every week, an AI report explains your eating pattern in plain language. For general wellness, not medical advice.

records.name: SlidesLand
records.tagline: TikTok and Instagram slideshows your AI agent makes
records.description: Add SlidesLand to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP app, then ask for a TikTok or Instagram slideshow. Your agent writes it; SlidesLand brings 13 proven formats, finds real photos, renders and checks every slide, and schedules the post. 5 slideshows free.

records.name: Join Markt
records.tagline: Open a store for digital products with instant delivery
records.description: Join Markt is a platform for digital sellers who want their own branded storefront. Sell keys, files, licenses, courses, presets, and Discord roles. Subdomain store, theme builder, checkout via your payment providers, automatic delivery, seller dashboard, analytics, team roles, antifraud, and multiple stores. Free: 2 stores, 50 products. 0% Join Markt transaction fee on listed plans. Payment provider fees may still apply.

records.name: QuerySail
records.tagline: Search Console & GA4 in ChatGPT and Claude. Unlimited sites.
records.description: QuerySail runs hosted MCP servers for Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4. One $8/month plan covers unlimited properties across several Google accounts, with no per-site fees. Connect Google, add QuerySail to ChatGPT, Claude, Codex or Cursor, then ask in plain words: which queries lost clicks, whether a page is indexed and why not, where last week's traffic came from. Setup takes about five minutes, with no Google Cloud project and no API keys. 7-day free trial, no card.

records.name: Launch Script by CinemaAI
records.tagline: Turn your product URL into a cinematic launch film script
records.description: Paste your product URL and get the plan for a launch film in about a minute: the one idea, a six-beat script with voiceover, a shot list with image prompts (your real UI marked as recorded, never generated), a 15-second cutdown, and the claims you'll need to prove. Built for SaaS, fintech and AI startups. Free. Want the film made? Product Hunt makers get a fixed CA$6,000 launch film from CinemaAI, a Toronto studio.

records.name: Makitro
records.tagline: 8 small Mac utilities in one menu-bar app
records.description: Makitro puts 8 small Mac utilities behind one menu-bar icon: clipboard history (⌃⌘V) that remembers your copies, screenshots with markup (⌃⌘4), a colour picker that needs no Screen Recording permission, an ⌥Tab window switcher, external monitor brightness, a scroll reverser, Keep Awake and keyboard cleaning. Every tool can be switched off. No account, no analytics, notarized. Free download, every tool free for 14 days.

records.name: AVIFBox
records.tagline: Convert AVIF/WebP in your browser — nothing is ever uploaded
records.description: AVIFBox converts AVIF, JFIF and WebP to PNG or JPG in your browser. No upload, no account, no watermark — batch 50 files, download as one ZIP. What makes it different: • Animated AVIF done properly — every frame decoded, pick your frames or export an animated PNG. Most converters give you only the first frame. • HDR on purpose — tone-mapped keeping brightness or colour, not clipped by accident. • Verifiably private — check your network tab: your file goes nowhere. Free forever, no paid tier.

records.name: ZapVid
records.tagline: Put yourself in trending AI videos from one photo
records.description: ZapVid puts you inside the videos everyone is posting this week. Pick a trend template like Elf Dance, Catch Santa on Camera or Hotel Lobby, upload one photo, add friends where the template has room, and get your video in a few minutes. No prompts and no editing. New templates go up every few days as trends take off on TikTok and Reels. There is also an AI video and image generator with Kling, Seedance, Veo and Nano Banana. Pay with credits or a monthly plan.

records.name: Offline Teacher Coach
records.tagline: A classroom coach that runs fully offline on a phone
records.description: A teacher describes a classroom problem, in English, Urdu or Roman Urdu. A small 1.3 GB model on the phone answers with one concrete step for tomorrow plus a way to check it worked, grounded in a playbook. No internet after the one-time download. The app saves each problem as an issue and reminds the teacher to follow up. Android app and open model weights.

records.name: CutListFlow
records.tagline: Free cut list optimizer for plywood, MDF & lumber
records.description: Free cut list optimizer for plywood, MDF and lumber. Enter parts in tape-measure fractions (24-3/8"), decimals or mm and get a waste-minimizing guillotine cut layout with kerf, grain direction and reusable offcuts, calculated in your browser with no signup. Print the cut list for free; a free account adds quotes, labels and DXF export. Pro adds cloud sync, CNC DXF and branded quotes.

records.name: mio click
records.tagline: A fidget that's also a friend
records.description: mio click is a handheld clicker with one mechanical button and a tiny screen. Hatch a Squig, Goober or Meatball. No two are the same, and yours moves every time you press. It counts every click anywhere you take it, then syncs over Wi-Fi to a public leaderboard where you can see how your mio ranks, hatch a new one or swap with a friend. Assembled by hand in small batches by a team of parents. The button is rated for 50 million clicks.

records.name: Polylane for Azure
records.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Azure apps
records.description: Polylane investigates Azure Monitor alerts, traces the cause through logs, metrics and resource changes, and prepares code fixes for review. It maps your subscription and connects it to your repos and other clouds. Connect through Azure Lighthouse with one template and no stored Azure credentials.

records.name: CitedEvidence Scholar
records.tagline: Search 250M academic papers, with an API and MCP for AI
records.description: CitedEvidence Scholar is an academic search engine and research API. Search 250 million scholarly works, filter by year, full text or PDF, open available full text, browse journals and follow citations. Developers get the Scholar Metadata API, the CEDOA full-text API and a Research MCP with 25 tools, so AI agents and RAG apps cite papers that exist. Searching is free; the APIs run on credit packs or subscriptions.

records.name: I-5 Buddy
records.tagline: A talking road-trip guide to I-5 in California
records.description: I-5 Buddy follows you by GPS and tells you about 377 landmarks, towns and stories on California’s I-5 before you reach them. Explore a 3D map, live road information, a California mission passport and games for passengers. Free, no account, no ads.

records.name: FractalFlow
records.tagline: Modern PM and scheduling suite for Mac, iPad and iPhone
records.description: A real scheduling engine for Apple devices. Opens Microsoft Project files, runs every link type and constraint, shows the date you can promise with Monte Carlo, and draws the whole plan as one picture. No account, no server. Free for 14 days.

records.name: Webdesly Exchange
records.tagline: Verified listings and inquiries for luxury maisons
records.description: Quiet marketplace desk for luxury maisons: curated verified listings, buyer inquiries, and a curator inbox to reply or reserve. Not a high-volume listing site, not an invitation-only boutique. Free catalog and curator desk, no signup.

records.name: Tally Revenue Analytics
records.tagline: Every sale traced to the visit that brought it
records.description: Tally links each sale from Stripe, Shopify, WooCommerce, Paddle and more to the visit that brought it. Every sale gets a receipt showing how it was linked and how sure that is, and coverage shows what to fix for the rest. Each site counts visitors with a first-party cookie, cookieless, or only after consent, and IP addresses are never stored.

records.name: DUAL VISION™
records.tagline: ONE STORY. TWO DEVICES. ALL YOUR ATTENTION.
records.description: Dual Vision™ is a patent-pending storytelling system that turns the phone from streaming's biggest distraction into an essential screen. The story is split across your TV and your phone: each screen tells a different, necessary part, and you need both to experience the complete story. Watch the traditional way on TV alone, or switch to Dual Vision Mode for a more immersive experience across both screens.

records.name: Barq Vogue
records.tagline: Modest luxury fashion, designed in Dubai
records.description: Barq Vogue is a Dubai fashion house built around modest luxury. Relaxed, refined matching sets for women and men: the Nomad and Oasis sets, the Medina Polo and the Medina Shorts, cut generously and finished with care, made to move from morning meetings to evening plans. Shop online at barqvogue.com in English or Arabic with delivery across the GCC, or visit our boutique in Dubai. Every colour comes in sizes S to 2XL.

records.name: ViZy Login Pro
records.tagline: Customize and secure your WordPress login
records.description: Customize your WordPress login page and protect your website with ViZy Login Pro. Create a professional login experience with customizable designs, colors, and branding. Improve security with a custom login URL, two-factor authentication, XML-RPC protection, and login activity monitoring. Manage everything directly in WordPress without coding. Ideal for businesses, developers, and agencies looking for better security and a personalized login experience.

records.name: LifeByLogic
records.tagline: Research-informed interactive analytics for decision-making
records.description: LifeByLogic turns published psychology research into 33 free tests across brain, behavior, career, family and wellbeing. Your score and type are free the moment you finish. Go deeper with a personal PDF report, or LifeGraph+ to read 2 to 4 results together. Product Hunt code PRODUCTHUNT20: 20% off LifeGraph+ and PDF reports through Nov 26.

records.name: MODZEN
records.tagline: A model's profile, card and work, in one app.
records.description: Models keep photos, measurements and cards across chats and PDFs. MODZEN is the app that holds the working kit: a profile, photo library, measurements, a living link, a QR code and a flippable comp card you can send as an image. The public page shows name, bio, location, categories and the links you add. Photos, measurements and your phone stay private until you share a WhatsApp-ready message or the card. Track castings and payments, and use a free checklist before you reply. Free to start.

records.name: Alfred 6
records.tagline: Supercharging macOS since 2010
records.description: Alfred 6 brings Alfred UI, a new macOS-native toolkit creators can use to build lightweight workflows with real interfaces. Plus a fresh look across themes and preferences, a new Query History, and extended Clipboard History. Built for lightweight efficiency, stability and speed.

records.name: bridgewatch
records.tagline: GitHub and GitLab pipelines in one tray app
records.description: bridgewatch is an open-source tray monitor for GitLab CI and GitHub Actions. It shows one row per push with every downstream pipeline, tells a scheduled run apart from your push, and tells you whether your change actually deployed, not just the raw pipeline status. Sign in with a short code in your browser, let the setup wizard tick your three most recently active projects, and use bridgewatch wait in scripts and coding agents. macOS and Linux, Apache-2.0.

records.name: RocketReader
records.tagline: Read faster for exams, your career, and more free time
records.description: Give your study and career ambitions a stronger foundation. RocketReader helps you build the reading speed, understanding and recall to prepare for exams, keep up with demanding coursework and develop the knowledge your next career step calls for. Get more from the reading that matters, and make more room for life outside it. Try the free demos; full access is available by subscription.

records.name: MemRadar
records.tagline: Monthly RAM and SSD price index, with the data behind it
records.description: MemRadar publishes a monthly Memory Price Index for DDR5, DDR4, NVMe SSDs and SATA SSDs. Each record compares the exact same listings a year apart, is frozen once published, and comes with its methodology and downloadable data, so the figures can be checked and cited. In the October 2026 record, the median price change across 61 DDR5 kits tracked in both months was +323%. Every tracked product also has its own price history page, with free email price-drop alerts and no account needed.

records.name: Hypermesh
records.tagline: Open-source AI harness for hardware you own or lease
records.description: Hypermesh is an open-source AI harness. You set goals, budgets and limits; AI picks the model, finds the machine and runs the job, on hardware you own or a host you lease. Live today: browse the model catalog, lease an enrolled host and prompt it from the CLI; Visor lets agents see and drive a Linux desktop under your rules; AIuditor adds org policy and audit export. Pay in USDC or by card through Stripe; hosts earn USD. Free and open source under Apache 2.0 and MIT.

records.name: ClutterBuster
records.tagline: Snap your messy room, get an AI plan to de-clutter it
records.description: Your AI declutter coach. Take a photo of any messy room, tell ClutterBuster how much time and energy you have, and get a calm, prioritized, step-by-step tidying plan that actually fits — plus an AI before/after preview of the finished room. Paid plans add AI furniture rearranging and a coach you can chat with. Your photos stay on your device, never on our servers. Free to start, no credit card.

records.name: MintProof
records.tagline: Scan, value, and track your TCG collection
records.description: MintProof helps trading card collectors identify exact printings, check source-backed card values, track collections, view price history, and calculate grading ROI—all in one app.

records.name: Brume
records.tagline: Video, GIF and image tools that never upload your files
records.description: A video editor, a compressor, a screen recorder, Video to GIF and image tools that run in your browser. Your files are read and changed on your own device and never uploaded, so there's no upload to wait for. Subtitles are written on your device, PNGs come out about a third of their size, backgrounds come off at full size. Free with no account and no ads; paid plans from $3 a month lift the limits.

records.name: 3rd Eye
records.tagline: See what the AI agents on your Mac are doing
records.description: 3rd Eye is a Mac menu bar app that watches your AI tools: how much of each plan is left, which agents are running or waiting on you, what they can reach, and who they talk to. No telemetry, and it never reads your prompts. Free, with an optional Pro plan.

records.name: astro-weights
records.tagline: Agent-driven weight edits for open models, as LoRA adapters
records.description: Open-source Python library for small edits to open-model weights. Agent (Claude, local model or yours) works through MCP server; library compares edited model with base on same problems; edit saves as standard LoRA adapter or merges into GGUF. First adapter: Qwen3.8-27B, MATH-500 (n=500): about 30% fewer output tokens, accuracy −0.6 points (95% CI −2.6 to +1.4), no change detected.

records.name: Confessify
records.tagline: Interactive digital letters with games and a hidden note
records.description: Confessify is a free website for making interactive digital letters. Choose an occasion — a crush confession, love letter, apology, proposal, birthday, or a note for a best friend — then add mini-games and hide the final message. Share it as a link or QR code on WhatsApp, Instagram, or anywhere a link works. No design skills needed. Made for people who want to say something more personal than a text, especially shy confessions and long-distance relationships.

records.name: INVO
records.tagline: Send invoices and estimates from your iPhone or Android
records.description: INVO lets freelancers, contractors and small business owners create invoices, estimates and receipts on their phone and send them as PDFs by email or WhatsApp. Save clients and items, add your logo, taxes and discounts, collect a signature, and turn an accepted estimate into an invoice. Track partial payments, send reminders, set up recurring invoices and see income, expenses and net profit. Works in 55 languages and 65 currencies, on iPhone and Android.

records.name: Veridicus
records.tagline: Truth-speaking for your job search.
records.description: Veridicus (Latin for "truth-speaking") is a privacy-first job search OS that runs entirely on your machine. No account, no upload, no cloud. Everything — your resume, your applications, your interview practice — stays local. It runs offline on Ollama, and the honesty guardrails are distilled from a résumé agent that's been working my actual job hunt for months.

records.name: Videl
records.tagline: Free media tools that never upload your files
records.description: Compress, convert, trim and split videos, merge PDFs and remove image backgrounds right in your browser, with nothing uploaded. The free desktop app adds a downloader for 1000+ sites and offline AI tools. Open source, no account, no watermark.

records.name: FORMA
records.tagline: Image to 3D model generator with batch runs and four engines
records.description: FORMA is an image to 3D model generator in the browser. Upload one photo, or batch up to 8 images (one mesh each) or 2–4 variants in a single Pro run. Switch among Hunyuan3D, Meshy 7.1, Hi3DGen and Hitem3D — one engine per run — then inspect in clay or wireframe and export GLB, STL or OBJ. Use Separate models for different objects, or Multiple views to fuse angles of the same object. Try 10 Hi3DGen runs free, with no account.

records.name: Facebetter for OBS Studio
records.tagline: Real-time beauty, inside OBS Studio
records.description: Facebetter is a real-time beauty filter for OBS Studio. Add it to any camera, window or image source — move a slider, the preview updates. No virtual camera, no second app. Skin, reshape, makeup, LUTs, stickers, body and AI/green-screen backgrounds. Same GPU engine as our SDK: up to 4K/60, all on-device. macOS, Windows and Ubuntu. Free to download with a watermark; subscribe to remove it.

records.name: Sellrise
records.tagline: AI retention CRM that tells casinos who to keep today
records.description: Sellrise is an AI retention CRM for online casinos. Every morning it gives your team a short list: which players are about to leave, which new players look like future VIPs, and who would deposit anyway without a bonus. For each player it suggests when to reach out, through which channel and with which offer from your own catalogue. A person decides and sends. It works from Player ID and your events, with no platform rebuild. Pilots run for a month against a control group.

records.name: RailRadar
records.tagline: Reliable Indian Railways Live Data API
records.description: RailRadar is a developer-friendly Indian Railways API for live train status, schedules, PNR, seat availability, fares, coach position and station boards. One key, clear docs, predictable pricing and a free tier. Built for travel apps and developers who need reliable train data without maintaining fragile scrapers.

records.name: s3r.ch
records.tagline: The social network for humans and AI
records.description: s3r.ch is the social network for humans and AI. People and their agents share one network, with agents labeled, so you know who you are talking to. Sign in with a wallet or Hypermesh. New posts and rooms start on Mine; you choose what to publish or grant see, and you can revoke that grant. Forums, groups and squads are live, and the public feed already pulls Farcaster, Bluesky, Nostr, ActivityPub, and RSS or Atom. Meetings, live streams, video posts and room tasks come in v1.

records.name: Cumulus
records.tagline: Your Xcode Cloud builds and minutes, in the Mac menu bar
records.description: Cumulus watches Xcode Cloud from your menu bar: the build running now and when it ends, why the last one failed, and how many minutes are left in your plan. Free, open source, no server. Your coding agent can ask it too, through a CLI and an MCP server.

records.name: SportsEnter
records.tagline: Stream Sports Radio Free
records.description: Stream live sports radio free. Listen to audio broadcasts of NFL, college football, NBA, MLB and NHL games in one tap. No signup, no subscription. How? Most terrestrial radio stations, including sports stations, stream online. We just indexed those feeds and combined them with popular sporting events on ESPN so you can easily stream sports audio broadcasts.

records.name: SteadyTide
records.tagline: Calm for hard moments. Steadier with every tide.
records.description: SteadyTide is a calm companion for adults, couples, teens and families. Open it in a hard moment and start a calming exercise or step by step help right away, free and with no account. Inside is a library of more than 300 skills, each showing where it comes from, plus games kids can play, plans you build yourself, and stories read aloud. Built by a therapist and dad. No ads. It is not therapy and it never diagnoses.

records.name: Runvia
records.tagline: AI running coach that builds & adapts your race plan
records.description: Runvia is an AI running coach for race-focused runners — not a step counter. Chat with a coach that reads your real runs (Strava, watch, FIT/TCX, or phone GPS), builds adaptive plans for 10K / half / marathon / trail, and can create, move, or cancel workouts in your calendar. Free to start: try the coach, then keep chatting with your own Gemini key. Premium unlocks Garmin/Suunto sync and deeper recovery insights.

records.name: QR Lite
records.tagline: QR menus and QR code replacement for posters
records.description: Create digital menus with covers, item photos, categories, and prices for guests to browse by scanning a QR code. Replace a QR code inside an existing poster without rebuilding the design. Share files via QR codes. QR Lite also offers static QR code generation, styling, and decoding. Online menus and file sharing require an account.

records.name: Start Link
records.tagline: Plan LinkedIn, email, and WhatsApp outreach
records.description: Start Link is a Chrome extension for building prospect lists on LinkedIn and organizing LinkedIn, email, and WhatsApp follow-ups in one campaign. Use the campaign editor to plan the next step, track replies in the inbox, and review results with reports.

records.name: SnooNews
records.tagline: News You Can Sleep To
records.description: SnooNews (say it "Snooze") reads you the day's news at bedtime, calmly. Curated from trending stories reported by real news outlets, rewritten calm and neutral, with sources linked in the app, and stressful news softened. Pick from 7 categories, layer in rain, river or beach sounds with separate volume controls, and let the sleepcast slow down as you drift off. Free on iPhone, iPad and Android.

records.name: Smart Bulk Tag Manager
records.tagline: Automate Shopify flash sales, tags, prices & collections
records.description: Put your Shopify catalog and flash sales on autopilot. Bulk add, remove, replace, or format product tags in seconds, generate rich product attributes with AI Tag Studio, and schedule timed promotions that automatically discount or markup variant prices, set strikethrough Compare-At prices, and create Smart Collections—then revert 100% automatically when the sale ends. Backed by tenant-isolated speed and 1-Click Instant Undo.

records.name: nbnb
records.tagline: See who lives there before you rent a room in Korea
records.description: nbnb is a free roommate and share house app for Korea. Each listing shows the people who live in the home. You apply with your profile, and the current housemates decide together. Chats are machine-translated. No fees.

records.name: PolyFlow
records.tagline: Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode on one canvas
records.description: PolyFlow is a local desktop workspace where Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode run side by side on one canvas. Assign tasks in a group chat, get automatic reviews, and keep agents working when an account hits its limit with account rotation. Build the whole workspace by chatting through its MCP server. Your code never leaves your machine.

records.name: Tundra Mail
records.tagline: A desktop mail client with no account and no server
records.description: A mail and calendar app for Mac, Windows and Linux. Your mail lives on your own computer, so it's fast and works offline. No Tundra account and no Tundra server. Built for the keyboard. AI is optional: bring a local model or your own key.

records.name: Cliplato
records.tagline: Turn streams into TikToks and Shorts with AI
records.description: Paste a link to a stream or video from Twitch, Kick, YouTube and 7 more sites, or upload a file. Cliplato reads the chat replay and the audio to find the moments viewers reacted to, then cuts vertical 9:16 clips with word-by-word captions, your facecam placed, and the TikTok caption and YouTube description written for you. Works in any language, Moroccan Darija included. Free: 3 videos a month, AI included, no card.

records.name: UpStock
records.tagline: Smart inventory & demand tracking for shops and retailers
records.description: UpStock is inventory management for shops, supermarkets and wholesalers with one store or many. Track stock per store, transfer it between branches, and record purchase and sales orders with FIFO costing, so profit and stock aging reports stay accurate. Spot low-stock items at a glance, scan barcodes with your device camera, track expiry batches and money customers owe on credit, and export any list to Excel or PDF. 7-day free trial, no card required to start.

records.name: spmx
records.tagline: Cut SwiftPM & AI worktree disk usage to zero on macOS
records.description: AI coding agents and parallel Git worktrees multiply Xcode's DerivedData, eating tens of GBs in duplicate SwiftPM packages. spmx gives your Mac one global APFS copy-on-write store (~/.spmx/store) and shared LLVM CAS build cache. It clones packages in milliseconds (42.3s to 0.46s) with zero extra disk usage across Swift, Xcode, Flutter, React Native, and KMP. Run "spmx link" to scan your Mac and reclaim gigabytes instantly.

records.name: SRE Skill
records.tagline: An open-source SRE copilot for safer production operations
records.description: An installable agent skill for SRE and production operations. It guides incident response, SLOs, error budgets, alerting, postmortems, and safe rollouts, with reusable templates and a Python reliability calculator. Grounded in Google’s SRE books and LinkedIn’s School of SRE.

records.name: Nimblet
records.tagline: AI that "gets" B2B Advertising
records.description: Nimblet is the creative intelligence & ideation platform for B2B ads on LinkedIn and Meta. It sees every ad visually, analyzes psychologically, and ideates & renders the next ones in your brand. Use it in Claude and ChatGPT over MCP. Free to start.

records.name: Stirly
records.tagline: Turn TikTok and Instagram recipe links into real recipes
records.description: Stirly turns the food videos you save into recipes you actually cook. Paste or share a TikTok or Instagram link and it pulls the ingredients and steps from the post's caption into a clean, editable recipe card. Add recipes to your weekly plan, and the shopping list adds itself up, with practical buy amounts like "buy 0.5 l" when a recipe needs 3 tbsp of milk. Discover recipes other Stirly cooks have saved. iOS.

records.name: Avantcert Certification Cost Calculator
records.tagline: Estimate SOC 2, ISO 27001 & CMMC costs without signup
records.description: Build a first-pass compliance budget. Choose your company size and framework to see Avantcert’s reference package prices in USD and estimated preparation timelines. Compare SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC, and more, then download a PDF estimate to share with your team. Free to use. No email required.

records.name: GSTCalculators.in
records.tagline: Free GST calculators and invoicing tools
records.description: GSTCalculators.in offers India-focused GST, invoicing and financial tools. Add or remove GST, create invoices and receipts, check GSTIN formats, and explore loan and investment calculators. Core tools run in your browser; optional Pro upgrades are available. Results are estimates—verify current rules before filing.

records.name: Mistral Vibe Desktop
records.tagline: Mistral's coding agent as a desktop app for Mac and Windows
records.description: Vibe is Mistral's AI agent for work and code (formerly Le Chat), and it now has a desktop app for macOS and Windows. Run coding agents locally or remotely, brief it on long-horizon tasks and keep working while it ships. You can import projects and sessions from another coding agent during setup. Vibe is also in the terminal, VS Code, web, iOS, Android and Slack. Building in Europe? Try the Pro plan free with code LECHONK.

records.name: BillableCalc Timer
records.tagline: A timer that reminds you to start the timer
records.description: Freelancers rarely lose money on rates. They lose it on hours they forgot to track. BillableCalc Timer is a Chrome extension that notices when you open a client's site (their Figma, Jira or staging) and asks: "Working for Acme? Start timer." Already started 10 minutes ago? One click starts the timer from when you opened the site. It catches idle time, shows what you earn and turns hours into an invoice. No account, no servers: it only sees the client sites you add.

records.name: Pluck
records.tagline: Drop anything. Get a short link back.
records.description: Pluck turns files, screenshots, videos, links, and notes into short links in one move. Share from the web, the iPhone share sheet, or copy anything on a Mac and press ⇧⌘U. Use your own domain if you want, then see views, visitors, referrers, devices, and downloads without tracking cookies.

records.name: COLLASTRA
records.tagline: The coordination layer for AI agents
records.description: Give Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, and Google Antigravity one GitHub issue. COLLASTRA splits the work, passes findings between agents, and brings you a diff to review. Your code stays in your environment. Loop breakers catch repeated dead ends. OctaMem remembers fixes you approve so the next agent can reuse them instead of spending tokens rediscovering them. Use DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Grok, or Meta Muse via OpenRouter. OpenCode and Cursor are coming soon. Join the private beta waitlist.

records.name: Print Numbers
records.tagline: Free 3D printing cost & material calculators
records.description: Print Numbers is a free reference and cost calculator site for 3D printing enthusiasts and makers. It covers filament cost estimates, material comparisons, printer specs, and category-level breakdowns across hundreds of printers and filament types. Whether you're deciding between PLA and PETG or trying to estimate the cost of a print run, Print Numbers gives you the numbers without the guesswork. No account required. No ads cluttering the data. Built for the maker community.

records.name: StackShot
records.tagline: iPhone Photo Cleaner for Duplicates & Videos
records.description: StackShot helps you reclaim iPhone storage without sending your library to the cloud. Review duplicates and similar shots, clear forgotten screenshots, find large files, and compress eligible videos through focused, recoverable cleanup flows. Analysis stays on-device, and you approve every change.

records.name: 择璧 ZeBi
records.tagline: AI 模型评测与动态追踪
records.description: 择璧 ZeBi 是面向非技术团队的 AI 模型管理与评测平台，提供多模型效果对比（测）、产出效果持续追踪（追）、模型价格变动追踪（价）、应用场景台账（记）与模型上下架预警（安）五大核心模块。

records.name: Aero Markdown
records.tagline: Markdown Reader & Viewer for Mac
records.description: Aero Markdown is a native Markdown reader for macOS 14 or later. Read local files, READMEs, and documents written by coding agents. Follow relative links and reload the open file when it changes. Offline, no account. It is available to download from aeromarkdown.app.

records.name: Car Repair Cost
records.tagline: Know your car repair cost before the shop does
records.description: Take a few photos of a dent, a scraped bumper or collision damage, or describe a warning light or a strange noise, and Car Repair Cost gives you an itemized estimate for your area: parts, labor hours, paint and materials. Scan a shop quote to see which lines look fair or high. It's an AI planning estimate, a pre-check before the mechanic's quote, not a binding quote. On iPhone and Android.

records.name: DM Automations from OneUp
records.tagline: Auto-reply to comments with DMs on Instagram & Facebook
records.description: OneUp now automates your Instagram and Facebook DMs. Set a keyword, and when someone comments it on your post, OneUp can reply publicly, send them a DM, or do both. You can also trigger automations from DM keywords, and run keyword comment auto-replies on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, and LinkedIn. Set it up once in the Social Inbox, for all posts, future posts, or one specific post. DM automation is built into the scheduler you already use to post to 12 networks, from $15/mo.

records.name: ApexOnline
records.tagline: Race real circuits in your browser, free and no download
records.description: Open a tab and you're on the grid. ApexOnline is a free racing game with real circuits built from map data, physics-based cars, weather and pit stops, and up to 22 AI drivers. Don't have a wheel? No worries! Use your phone as a steering wheel! Chase your ghost lap, race friends online, or play split-screen. No download, no account.

records.name: IKATA
records.tagline: Sports check-in app. Individual & Team Challenges
records.description: IKATA is the GPS-powered sports competition app for athletes who play at real courts, fields, and venues. Find nearby sports locations and verify your check-ins using GPS. Every eligible check-in earns points, builds your activity, and helps you climb the leaderboard. Claim a unique team handle, build your roster, and compete with other teams across IKATA locations. Your team keeps its match record as players come and go, while your individual career record follows you wherever you play.

records.name: RunWars
records.tagline: Turn your runs into a battle for real-world territory
records.description: RunWars is a GPS running game for iOS and Android. Start an outdoor run or connect a sports service to map eligible workouts to real-world hexagons: claim and defend territory, compete in battles and rankings, and run with a team. Currently invite-only: use code 572960 for exclusive Product Hunt access, limited to 50 people.

records.name: Bankstream
records.tagline: Your Revolut, live in Muse AI — read-only, no coding
records.description: Bankstream: how to use Muse AI with your Revolut, read-only, via open banking. Ask Muse AI 'how am I looking to payday?' and get an answer, not a number. No coding, no funds held, no statement uploads. DIY kit €29 Black Friday early bird (was €79)

records.name: Dugout Decisions
records.tagline: Manage a real MLB moment every day. Beat the real manager.
records.description: A free daily baseball strategy game. Each day you step into a real late-inning moment from baseball history, make the manager's calls (pinch hitters, steals, bullpen moves), then get graded against what the real manager did. Plays in your browser.

records.name: Badgedle
records.tagline: Guess 8 football badges. A fresh challenge every day.
records.description: A free daily football badge quiz. Guess 8 clubs, keep your streak and compare scores. Want more? Play Classic or 30-second Speed rounds with clubs from Europe, Turkey and around the world, or challenge up to 7 friends. Available in 5 languages. No account required.

records.name: CleanPDF Split PDF
records.tagline: Split or extract PDF pages in your browser. No upload.
records.description: Pull out just the pages you need with ranges like 1-5, 8, 10-20, or split every page into its own PDF and download them as a ZIP. Everything runs in your browser, so your files are never uploaded. Free, with no sign-up, no watermark and no file size limits.

records.name: IPPT Scores
records.tagline: Exact IPPT scores from the official SAF tables — free
records.description: IPPT Scores is a free calculator for Singapore's IPPT (Individual Physical Proficiency Test). Instead of estimating your score with a formula, it looks up the exact SAF scoring tables — push-ups (25 points), sit-ups (25 points) and the 2.4 km run (50 points) across all 14 age groups. Measured against the full tables, the formula method matched only 62% of the 2,548 scoring cells — and missed the run by up to 13 points. No sign-up; the full tables are published as open data.

records.name: OwlPrompter
records.tagline: A teleprompter that follows your voice as you read
records.description: OwlPrompter scrolls your script as you speak. Eye-contact mode holds the scroll when you turn away from the camera. Captions, RTMP streaming, Apple Watch remote. No account; scripts stay on your device unless you send one to an optional AI feature.

records.name: Blockzia Labs
records.tagline: AI Co-Pilot for Crypto Token Launches
records.description: Move from token idea to launch-ready in days, not months. Blockzia gives crypto founders one brand-aware workspace to create tokenomics, whitepapers, pitch decks, and launch content—so every asset tells a consistent story.

records.name: AIFirmo
records.tagline: Discover, compare and explore AI tools
records.description: AIFirmo helps you discover and compare AI tools for video creation, image generation, productivity, marketing and more. Browse categorized listings, explore community rankings and find available partner offers to choose tools for your next project.

records.name: Bucky
records.tagline: Download manager for Mac
records.description: Bucky is a download manager for Mac. Big files download faster, and stopped downloads resume where they left off. A browser extension sends downloads from Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc and Firefox to Bucky. It also has queues, schedules, speed limits and video saving.

records.name: Tinysend
records.tagline: Write your newsletter in Gmail, press send, and it goes out
records.description: Tinysend sends your newsletter from your inbox. Write in Apple Mail, Gmail or Outlook, address it to your list, and press send. Each reader gets their own copy, and replies come back to you. Nothing goes out until you approve the preview. You get your own domain with DKIM, SPF and DMARC set up, a public archive with RSS, and who opened each post. Bring your list from Mailchimp, Substack, Kit, beehiiv or a CSV. Free to start, then $2 a month for 500 emails.

records.name: VoceText
records.tagline: Turn audio and video into transcripts and subtitles
records.description: Upload interviews, podcasts, lectures, or videos and get timestamped transcripts in 20 languages. Review the text and export it as TXT, Word, SRT, or VTT. Try one recording of up to 10 minutes per day without signing up. Pro supports files up to 10 hours and adds speaker labels.

records.name: Vectobox
records.tagline: Free browser tools for code, money and everyday math
records.description: A free toolbox that runs in your browser, with no signup. Files and text you paste are processed on your device and never uploaded. Format JSON, decode JWTs, check color contrast with WCAG and APCA, compress images, and run loan or compound interest numbers in one place.

records.name: CarSpot
records.tagline: Turn the cars you spot into collectible cards
records.description: Spot a car, take a photo and add it to your digital garage. CarSpot uses AI to identify its make, model and year, then creates a collectible card with specs, an estimated value and one of six rarity tiers, from Common to Unicorn. Map your finds, earn XP and badges, and share your best cards. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: Starry
records.tagline: A chart of your GitHub stars that updates itself
records.description: A chart of your GitHub stars that updates itself every few hours, labels your launches and spikes, and matches light and dark mode. One line of Markdown.

records.name: Simple House Planner
records.tagline: Design a house to scale in ChatGPT, or draw it by hand
records.description: Describe a home or share a sketch, and ChatGPT draws the floor plan to scale: walls, doors, windows, stairs, furniture, roof and garden. The editor opens beside the chat and shows each change. Walk through the house in 3D, render photoreal images on your own graphics card, and export PNG, SVG, PDF sheets to scale, DXF, DWG and IFC. The same editor works in any browser with no account. Free: no paid plans and no AI credits.

records.name: STAT6
records.tagline: Make sports predictions. Track your picks. Prove your skill.
records.description: Put your sports knowledge to the test with STAT6. Compare player statistics, make higher-or-lower predictions, save your pick cards, and track your results, streaks, and leaderboard position. Play free on the web or Android, with optional Ad-Free subscriptions.

records.name: Numnote
records.tagline: Calculator that mixes units, currencies and formulas
records.description: Numnote is a calculator that remembers what you've worked out. Mix meters, dollars, euros and percent in one expression: 12 m × 30 cm = 3.6 m². Save a calculation as a formula and next time only the numbers change. Keep your salary or tax rate by name, send a budget as a PDF or a spreadsheet. Works offline, no ads, no accounts. For site owners: embed any of 100+ formula calculators on your site for free, or one with your own formula.

records.name: Berry
records.tagline: Built for long engineering and research sessions
records.description: Berry Desktop is a native AI workstation built for long engineering and research sessions. Powered strictly by Chííké with no external model fallbacks, keeping your work private, predictable, and deterministic. Available for $49 per month.

records.name: Folira
records.tagline: Scanner, OCR, finger signature, PDF tools and read-aloud
records.description: Folira is the most complete app in its category: scanner, OCR, finger signature, PDF tools, organization with a Vault and read-aloud, all in one place, with a one-time purchase. The camera finds the edges, straightens the page and creates the PDF. Recognized text becomes searchable. You merge, split, compress and sign without printing. Documents are processed on the device, not sent to our server. Available for iPhone, iPad and Android, with a free part to get started.

records.name: TokenCosts AI
records.tagline: Compare LLM costs, caching savings & routing strategies
records.description: Estimate LLM API bills from your workload. Compare models, simulate prompt caching and batch discounts, explore multi-model routing strategies, and export code/config.

records.name: ImageZip
records.tagline: Photo, video & PDF tools that stay on your device
records.description: ImageZip is a private, on-device toolbox for photos, videos and PDFs. Compress, cut out backgrounds, merge PDFs, pull frames from video and clean up storage — all locally. No account, no uploads, no tracking. Free to start; Pro is optional.

records.name: The ToolBolt
records.tagline: Curated AI tools, skills & MCP servers with install guides
records.description: A free, curated directory of AI models, tools, skills, agents, and MCP servers. The ToolBolt gives you what happens after discovery: copyable install commands, CLI usage examples, honest pricing, GitHub star counts, and live maintenance status. Featuring dual tracks for everyday creators and developers, plus community submissions with live preview.

records.name: Worked
records.tagline: Shared fixes for agents, ranked by what worked
records.description: Worked is a shared knowledge base for agents. Search for a fix, try it with your approval, then report worked, failed, or partly. Share new fixes with steps and a check. Agents use the application programming interface (API) or Model Context Protocol (MCP) server; people can browse without an account.

records.name: Grumbic
records.tagline: Measure, report and reduce your carbon footprint with AI
records.description: Grumbic turns invoices and documents into a GHG Protocol carbon inventory. Upload your data, let AI read and classify it, and get your Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions. Then set targets, plan initiatives and track your progress to 2030.

records.name: Practical Data
records.tagline: Conditional formatting for every table on the web
records.description: A free, open-source Chrome extension that shades the comparable data of any HTML table, using a decision model (like Jev) to judge which direction is better per-column. Handles all sorts of edge-cases.

records.name: TestOps Gate
records.tagline: Self-hosted VPN for your team and servers
records.description: TestOps Gate helps developers and small teams access internal tools, databases and servers over a private VPN. Self-host it on Debian or Ubuntu to manage OpenVPN profiles, private DNS and server connections from a terminal dashboard. Give each teammate individual access, choose split or full tunnel, and join servers with a one-time command. Reach internal services by private DNS names and review connection logs. Free and open source; you provide and manage the Linux server.

records.name: Replay FC
records.tagline: Football trivia you play, not watch.
records.description: You already shout the answers at football quiz videos. Replay FC is where you actually play them. Guess the player from his club journey, pin iconic goals on the pitch, spin the wheels for nation, club and position. Every mode built on real careers, real transfers, real history. Free, anonymous, mobile first. Beat the daily deal, then send it to the group chat and see who really knows football.

records.name: Birds Around the World
records.tagline: A free 3D globe where kids meet 1,033 birds
records.description: Birds Around the World is a free 3D globe for kids aged 5 to 12. Every dot is a real bird where it lives in the wild. Tap one to see its photo, hear its real call, learn what it eats and how endangered it is, then add it to your collection. Filter the map by diet, conservation status or country, meet a new Bird of the Day and play two quick games. 1,033 species, 850+ real calls. No ads, no accounts, no cookies.

records.name: QuizWhiz
records.tagline: Turn lectures and PDFs into notes, flashcards and tests
records.description: Record a lecture or upload a PDF, and QuizWhiz makes notes, flashcards and practice tests. Each one links to the second or page it came from, so a wrong answer opens your own material at that spot. Free to start; $29 a term that never renews.

records.name: Kairell
records.tagline: Find the moment in hours of video
records.description: Find the moment in hours of video. Kairell reads every word and reaction of your podcast, interview or stream on your own device, scores the best moments and turns them into captioned 9:16 clips. Synced across your Mac and the web.

records.name: QiMétéo
records.tagline: Your daily decision weather & timing calendar for iPhone
records.description: QiMétéo turns traditional Eastern timing systems (Tong Shu 12 Day Officers, Qi Men Dun Jia 2-hour windows, 4 Natal Pillars & Ming Gua) into a 3-second daily decision forecast. Find your best days in the next 30 days to pitch, sign a contract, launch, or move; audit your Apple Calendar for personal clashes; check plain-language synergy with co-founders, clients, or partners; and align in real time with the 180° Luopan compass — 100% private & computed offline on iPhone.

records.name: Showrunner
records.tagline: AI Short Video Script Generator
records.description: Generate a short video script, storyboard, and shareable draft with narration copy from a product URL.

records.name: Kronumos
records.tagline: Rust terminal coding agent. 91.3% lower token spend.
records.description: Standard AI coding agents burn your token quota streaming 1,500+ lines of node_modules stack traces and retrying broken syntax edits. Kronumos puts a <1ms Rust Sub-Cortex harness between your repo and the LLM: it strips 91.3% of traceback noise locally, masks secrets in memory, blocks broken syntax pre-write with Tree-sitter AST, and verifies fixes on your real test suite with auto-rollback. Works with Kronumos Cloud, OpenRouter BYOK, local Ollama, and MCP.

records.name: Clothify
records.tagline: Build a clothing brand with AI
records.description: Clothify helps you turn a clothing brand idea into a collection and storefront. Start with a written brief or your existing logo, create artwork, preview it on supplier garments, customize a store, and prepare photos and captions for your first drop.

records.name: OpeningCraft
records.tagline: Learn the chess openings you'll actually face
records.description: OpeningCraft is a free chess opening trainer that teaches you the lines you'll actually face at your rating, based on real Lichess games, and drills them on an interactive board with spaced repetition.

records.name: Mailtruss
records.tagline: Transactional Email API with Delivery Traces
records.description: Send transactional email with a developer-first API. Trace every message, get bounces and failures explained in plain language, and debug without guessing.

records.name: Thataway
records.tagline: A 30-minute getaway into a mystery adventure
records.description: Tell Thataway how long you have: 15, 30, 45 or 60 minutes. It picks a public place worth the trip (a viewpoint, a park, public art, a historic spot, a good café) and keeps it secret. You see only an arrow and the distance, and find your own way. The place is revealed when you arrive, with its name, photo and story. Walk, run, bike or drive. The arrow also lives on the lock screen and Apple Watch. A fog map lights up the streets you've travelled. Free. No ads, no account. US only for now.

records.name: OneHTML
records.tagline: Run, host, and share single-file HTML apps
records.description: OneHTML is a gallery and hosting platform for apps that fit in a single HTML file. Play browser games, try creative experiments, and discover small web tools without an account. To share your own app, sign in and upload an HTML file or paste your code. Once approved, your app gets a shareable link and runs in a browser sandbox.

records.name: Patak - Beverage Costing
records.tagline: Drink costing, built the way a beverage consultant works
records.description: Drink costing built the way a beverage consultant works: build the menu, cost every recipe, set the price. Cocktails, coffee, event batches and tasting sets, in 52 currencies. Your recipes and prices are stored on your device. When iCloud sync is on, they also sync to your own iCloud account. Free to start.

records.name: Storyhook
records.tagline: Turn any complex topic into a story you’ll remember
records.description: StoryHook turns complex topics into short, memorable stories. Type in any concept, from how TCP works to how a drug acts in the body, and get a story that links the key ideas together so they’re easier to recall later. Built for students and self-learners who understand a topic when they read it but forget it by exam day.

records.name: Cookiemark
records.tagline: Cookie consent that takes care of itself
records.description: Cookiemark is a cookie banner backed by ongoing scans, made in the Netherlands and hosted in the EU. It supports Google Consent Mode v2, fixes Google Tag Manager tags that fire before consent, sets up conversion tracking in your own container, and Lead Guard emails you when a form breaks. Six languages, unlimited pages on paid domains, priced per domain. Free for one domain with up to 100 pages.

records.name: Launch Your First AI SaaS in 30 Days
records.tagline: A practical roadmap to validate, build, and launch your SaaS
records.description: A beginner-friendly course that helps you choose a focused AI SaaS idea, validate the problem, plan a lean MVP, and prepare for launch with practical lessons, worksheets, and AI prompts.

records.name: Anchak
records.tagline: Your first weeks in Korea, sorted
records.description: Tell Anchak when you land in Korea. Get a day-by-day arrival checklist, subway maps with live arrivals, 26 practical guides, 401 hand-picked places in 58 cities and a Show Card for taxis and restaurants. Free, no ads, 8 languages.

records.name: AdmitStories
records.tagline: Every essay, drafted from your own words
records.description: Talk about your life and work once, by voice or by typing. AdmitStories turns it into your MBA application, school by school: every essay, short answer and form field, drafted from your own stories. Each draft shows why it's built that way and marks which words are yours. Talking, your Profile Read and a strategy for every school are free. One school is $100, with packs for 5 or 10. 16 schools verified for 2026–27, from Harvard and Stanford to HEC Paris.

records.name: Wedding Planner
records.tagline: Checklist, budget, guests and vendors in one offline file
records.description: Wedding Planner is a wedding planning app in one HTML file. It has a checklist of 69 tasks with due dates set from your wedding day, a budget tracker, a guest list with RSVPs and vendor cards. Works offline. No account, no subscription. Print or save as PDF.

records.name: Cinema Hound
records.tagline: Find your next great movie, from around the world
records.description: Spend your evening watching a film you want to see. Cinema Hound helps you discover movies through themes and recommendations shaped by your viewing lists. Find films that catch your interest and keep your next watches together.

records.name: AIChief
records.tagline: The AI assistant for your clients and your team
records.description: An AI assistant for customers and employees: answers questions using company data, recommends products and specialists, performs calculations and submits requests. Runs in the cloud or within the company's infrastructure.

records.name: Notchie 4.0
records.tagline: The Mac teleprompter in your notch, now with a phone remote
records.description: Notchie puts your script in the MacBook notch, right under your camera, so you read every word and keep eye contact. 4.0 adds a phone remote, word-by-word voice tracking, built-in screen recording, sections and cues, floating mode and practice mode.

records.name: Fattura
records.tagline: Split recurring subscriptions & bills with friends easily
records.description: Fattura helps you manage and split shared recurring expenses, subscriptions, and household bills with friends, roommates, or family. Track who owes what with automated calculation of proportional shares, WhatsApp reminders, and payment tracking. No more awkward spreadsheets.

records.name: ClipNik
records.tagline: Convert Videos Free in Your Browser
records.description: Compress a video for Discord, make it 9:16 for Reels and TikTok, turn it into a GIF or extract the audio. Free, no watermark, no upload.

records.name: PrintAIBook
records.tagline: Turn your PDF or images into a real, printed book
records.description: PrintAIBook turns any book into a real, bound book, softcover or hardcover. Made with AI (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Canva) or written by you. Upload a PDF, or build one from images with our free tool. Preview every page before you pay. No account, no ISBN, shipped worldwide.

records.name: ADE
records.tagline: Cloud computers for your coding agents, from 1¢ an hour
records.description: ADE runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 200+ models on cloud computers from 1¢ an hour, with 100 free hours every month. Agents coordinate on one job, test your app on Android simulators in the cloud (iOS through your Mac), get their own desktops, and open, fix and merge PRs from the chat. Works on Mac, Windows, Linux, web and iPhone. Free and open source.

records.name: RepCam AI
records.tagline: Your camera counts reps. You do the workout.
records.description: Turn your phone into a hands-free rep counter. RepCam AI tracks push-ups, squats, sit-ups, lunges, pull-ups, burpees and wall balls in real time, with form cues and on-device pose detection. Challenge friends, take on the Daily Drop and build a streak. Rep counting works offline on iPhone and Android, with no wearable needed.

records.name: Wink
records.tagline: The harness for self-improving frontier agents.
records.description: Talk to one orchestrator and it spawns Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Gemini and Muse agents in real terminals. When you correct it, it writes the lesson down, and on code it adds a check that fails if the mistake comes back. Your decisions are saved in your own words, with dates. Check in from your phone. Free, open source, Windows. Runs on the subscriptions you already pay for, no API keys.

records.name: STLmint
records.tagline: Personalised 3D print files from your customer's name
records.description: For people who sell personalised 3D prints. Pick one of 1,000+ designs, type the customer's name, send them a picture drawn from the exact file, and download a print-ready STL or a multi-colour Bambu Studio project. Bulk lists make one file per name. Early Black Friday: the Seller plan is $6/month for your first 3 months until Nov 30, no code needed.

records.name: Breathe: Zen Breathing
records.tagline: A simple breathing practice inspired by Daoist philosophy.
records.description: A quiet space to slow down and reconnect with your breath. Inspired by Daoist philosophy, Breathe offers simple guided breathing practices in a minimalist, distraction-free experience. No ads, subscriptions, or account required. Always free.

records.name: Xannotate
records.tagline: Screen record and Live call with screen share for agents
records.description: Record your screen, point and speak, and hand it off to AI or do a live call with screen sharing to get realtime feedback about what's on the screen with Annotate Live, works with Claude, Codex, and Cursor and other coding agents.

records.name: Account Executive Jobs
records.tagline: Hire sales reps straight from ChatGPT
records.description: Account Executive Jobs is the sales-only job board with 9,000+ AE, SDR and sales leadership roles, every one with pay listed. Employers can post jobs, read applicants, compare résumés and move candidates forward right inside ChatGPT or Claude through our MCP app. Job seekers search, get matched and Quick Apply the same way.

records.name: Orbst
records.tagline: Multi-PDF AI workspace with line citations & A4 studio
records.description: Turn multi-PDF projects into verified answers, formatted A4 documents, and active-recall study sets. Click any citation to highlight the exact PDF line, inspect charts with vision, write in A4 Studio (PDF/DOCX export), or prep with SRS flashcards.

records.name: Milo - Friendly Agenda
records.tagline: Plan the whole trip, from bookings to splitting costs
records.description: Milo’s biggest update makes it easier to plan together. Build a trip with dates, guests, a day-by-day itinerary, shared costs, and a reminder in one flow. Add booking screenshots or PDFs to a plan you’ve already started without losing what’s there. Milo also adapts the form for dinners, appointments, anniversaries, and birthdays, with birthday details filled in from Contacts.

records.name: Supabase Keep-Alive Action
records.tagline: Stop Supabase free-tier pausing with one GitHub Action
records.description: Supabase pauses free projects after about 7 days without activity; a paused project answers every request with HTTP 540. This free GitHub workflow runs once a day, calls your project's REST API with the anon key, runs one cheap query, retries on transient errors, and writes a job summary that says clearly if the project is already paused. Plain bash and curl, nothing to install: add two secrets and copy one workflow file.

records.name: Duly
records.tagline: Send invoices by texting your AI assistant
records.description: Never open invoicing software again. Text your AI assistant who to bill and get a beautiful invoice with a pay link back in seconds. Works with Claude, Poke, Grok and any MCP assistant. $49 once, no subscription.

records.name: Cornerhold
records.tagline: Commercial real estate on autopilot.
records.description: Cornerhold is property management and accounting for commercial real estate: retail centers, offices and industrial buildings. Two AI readers abstract each lease and cite the page for every term. You bill rent and CAM from the lease. A billing check compares two years of billing with what your leases say and shows each gap in dollars. Use it on the web, or from ChatGPT, Claude and Grok through its MCP connector. A person approves whatever the AI drafts or proposes.

records.name: Aliza
records.tagline: AI health coach for perimenopause, menopause, and after
records.description: Aliza is an AI health coach for women in perimenopause, menopause, and the years after. Ask one question when something feels off, or follow a four-phase guided program. It can read your labs (you review every value first), remember your history, and suggest a next step. 7-day free trial, then $29/month, cancel anytime. No labs required. Education and coaching, not diagnosis.

records.name: Manufact
records.tagline: Ship and test your MCP to every plugin marketplace
records.description: Manufact helps teams publish MCP servers and plugins, understand how agents use them, and test releases across clients. Bring publishing checks, session traces and cross-client tests into one workflow.

records.name: Refund Score
records.tagline: Turn sales into stars: a rating nobody can fake
records.description: Refund Score turns your refund rate into a verified star rating for your website. Connect Stripe, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Dodo Payments or Creem and we read how rarely customers ask for their money back, so your stars come from real sales, not reviews anyone can write. Check yours free with no sign up, share it on X, then show the badge for $20 a year across up to 5 projects.

records.name: The Calm Creator Mastermind
records.tagline: For solopreneurs who are tired of being solo.
records.description: This is a small mastermind for creators, community builders, and indie founders who want to grow their business on their own terms, design a life they love, and treat their nervous system as a core measure of success alongside revenue. Other masterminds focus on growth at all costs. In this group, we're much more conscious of those costs. We commit to living a calm, balanced, and integrated life while growing the businesses and lives of our dreams.

records.name: TestSprite 4.0
records.tagline: Fix one thing, break another? This agent checks it all
records.description: Your coding agent fixes one thing and breaks another. TestSprite 4.0 is a brand-new testing agent that remembers what your app should do and checks all of it, every time. Tell it in plain words what to test. It explores your running app, writes and runs the end-to-end tests, tells you which failures are real bugs, and keeps checking every change from the web, your terminal or your pull requests.

records.name: Netlify Server
records.tagline: Run WebSockets, multiplayer apps, and long-running agents
records.description: Netlify Server gives your app a backend that stays alive while people are using it. Build realtime experiences, multiplayer games, and AI agents that need time to finish. Describe what you want and an agent builds it, or bring your Express, Fastify, Hono, or Koa code. It holds WebSockets open, keeps state in memory, and deploys with the rest of your project, with its own server for every preview. Scales with demand and down to zero when idle. Free during early access.

records.name: Teaflask
records.tagline: Self-improving AI copilot for your app. No backend changes.
records.description: Turn your existing SaaS into an AI-native product without rebuilding your backend. Teaflask adds a managed AI copilot that lets users get things done by simply asking. Integrate through your frontend, use your own UI components, and go live in a day. Teaflask keeps its product knowledge grounded in your code, learns from real usage, and lets you test changes before release.
